provenance: Trained on 760 real TomTom-observed OSM edges (single spatial snapshot, 2026-08-27) + 13 real TomTom-monitored road segments polled repeatedly over ~3 days (2026-08-26 onward). NOT a citywide model: covers ~0.2% of the 393,090-edge Bengaluru OSM graph with real labels; other edges have no ground truth and must be treated as graph-propagated estimates, not measurements. See traffic_module/models/prepare_real_traffic_dataset.py for exact source files and mapping methodology.
